summary: Tested the backend and frontend for the US mobile number ($75), the eSIM page changes, the IVR 'Send the caller a text' key and two regressions. Backend: new pytest file test_mobile_ivr_sms_iter192.py, 20/20 pass. It covers 401 without login; GET /mobile-numbers; bad ZIPs ('12', empty, 'abcde', '123456') return 400 with no charge; a short wallet returns 402; buying with ZIP 10011 charges $75 and returns kind mobile, provisioning, phoneNumber null, then active with a +1555 number after about 20 s; mobile lines never appear in GET /esim; qr and email-qr return 400 for mobile lines; auto-renew and cancel work; the Messages numbers list has mobile:true, calls:false, pictures:false; a $0.05 send works through /esim/:id/sms and /messages/send; the IVR PUT rejects missing text, a missing sender, another user's line and a cancelled line; it accepts and saves top-level and sub-menu sms keys, and any 'after' value other than 'menu' becomes 'hangup'; Bob gets empty items. The existing ivr_sms_key.test.js also passes. Frontend: on the eSIM page, line cards have no SMS composer or textarea, the mobile line is not listed, and 'Show install QR' shows the QR and 'Download QR code' (it downloads cloudivr-esim-qr.svg). The email-QR button stays disabled until the email is valid; sending shows the expected preview error toast and nothing crashes. In the eSIM buy form, Pay stays disabled until there is a 15-digit IMEI and a valid email. In the landing checkout, esim-co-qr-email is on the details step, esim-co-email is on the account step, and Next is gated on the email. On Buy a number with the US selected, the mobile-offer card shows $75.00/month and the reveal note. The ZIP field accepts digits only, up to 5, and Pay stays disabled until 5 digits. Paying goes to My numbers, which shows 'Number coming' and the pending text with the ZIP; the card switches to the number and Active by itself within about 25 s and shows the Messages link. Auto-renew toggles, and cancel (via the confirm dialog) removes the line. Switching to Canada hides the card. With a $10 wallet, the pay button is hidden, mobile-offer-pay-short shows '$65.00 short' and crypto is offered. In Messages, New message lists '+15554586272 · Mobile number'; sending to +14155550123 works (Sent (preview), $0.05), the thread header says 'Mobile number' and the attach button is hidden. On the IVR tab, the action select has 'sms: Send the caller a text'; sms-from lists 3 eSIMs and the mobile number; the counter, the say field and the after select (hangup/menu) work. Saving and reloading keeps all values, including an sms key inside a sub-menu. An empty text shows 'Key 1: write the text to send.' Regression: with a $10 wallet the campaign Start button is disabled and campaign-start-short shows '$10.00 short'. Alice's wallet ($549.78) and her +13346972125 IVR config were restored, and test lines were cancelled.

minor.issue: Runs against the real DB on Alice's active mobile line. Each run takes real $0.05 charges from her wallet and leaves phoneLogs behind (threads '+14155550199 Second press' now show in Alice's Messages). It needs a snapshot and restore of the wallet and phoneLogs.
A line that is still provisioning can't be cancelled ('Only active eSIMs can be cancelled.'), and the error message says 'eSIMs' for mobile lines.

Every mobile number is bought with the same SPENZA_TEXT_LINE_IMEI. Check that Spenza allows several active lines on one IMEI, otherwise the second purchase will fail or replace the first. The Idempotency-Key is set per line, so that is fine.

ui_bugs.issue: A thread on the Mobile number still shows the primary 'Call' button. call() sends DIAL_FROM with from=t.replyFrom, which is the mobile number, and that number can't make calls. The request says 'no call button for it'. Hide thread-call when t.number.mobile is true (or when caps.calls is false and no calling number is available).

The label overlap is fixed, but the knob is in the wrong place. The absolute knob span has no left-0, so it sits at its static position, which civr-btn's text-align:center puts in the centre (16px). With 'on' (translate-x-4) the measured offset is 32px, so the knob is fully outside the 32px pill and clipped by overflow-hidden: the pill shows as solid blue with no knob. With 'off' it sits on the right, so it looks 'on'. Fix: add left-0 to the knob span.

Pay is enabled for any 15-digit IMEI. There is no client-side Luhn check (for example 123456789012345 enables Pay), so the server's Luhn error only shows after the click. Use the same luhn() check in the disabled condition.

integration_issues.issue: Checked by code review only (Bob has no calling number). MobileOffer returns null when /mobile-numbers says available:false, so clicking '<prefix>-sms-buy' shows nothing and gives no message. The offer's 'My numbers' link also leaves the IVR page without the unsaved-changes guard.

If the saved smsFrom line is later cancelled, the select shows the first option, but the state keeps the stale id. Saving then fails with 'Pick one of your own texting numbers…' and nothing on screen explains why. Reset smsFrom when it isn't in the list.
Opens /app/messages with no filter for that mobile number.

issues: Unlike the eSIM dialog, it doesn't say that the $75 already paid isn't refunded.

action_items: Hide the Messages thread 'Call' button (thread-call) for Mobile number threads (t.number.mobile / !caps.calls). Right now it dials from a texts-only number.
Esim.js AutoRenew knob: add left-0 to the absolute knob span (the knob is invisible when on and wrongly placed when off).
Esim.js buy form: add a client-side Luhn check to the Pay disabled condition.
IvrSms: reset smsFrom when the saved line isn't listed, and show a message when MobileOffer is unavailable.

voice-service IVR sms: add a per-call limit (for example 1 to 3 texts per call or per caller per day). With after='menu' a caller can press the key again and again, each press takes $0.05 and texts the same person.

voice-service IVR sms after='menu' inside a sub-menu replays the top menu (ivrPath reset) and speaks the text greeting even when greetingType is audio. Decide whether 'play the menu again' should replay the sub-menu or the audio greeting.
Make ivr_sms_key.test.js restore Alice's wallet and remove the phoneLogs it creates.
critical_code_review_comments: numbers.js PUT /ivr ownership check accepts lines in 'provisioning' or 'suspended' status. sendSms requires 'active', so callers hear 'could not send' until the line is active. That is acceptable, but the UI could warn about it.
When a mobile or eSIM line is cancelled, IVR keys that use it are left as they are. Every press then fails and sends the owner a notification. Consider clearing or flagging those keys on cancel.

Callers outside the US always get a failed text plus an owner notification for each press (sendSms only allows +1 numbers). Consider checking the caller's number before sending and speaking a clearer line.
resendQr saves qrEmail before the send attempt, so a failed send still overwrites the stored checkout email.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (1 medium requirement miss: Call button on mobile thread; 2 low UI bugs)

rca of the issue: thread-call: Thread.js only checks t.number.kind==='calling' to pick the caller ID and otherwise falls back to replyFrom. The button is never hidden for numbers that can't call. AutoRenew knob: the absolute child has no horizontal inset, so the static position follows text-align:center from .civr-btn.
